title: Separate exact tables from finite measured probabilities
statement: Given prefix/suffix bases of size r, a PROMISE that complete controlled Hankel rank is <=r and an invertible probability block H, the standard observable-operator H^-1 H_c construction yields the finite representation. Its familiar linear-realization step is prior machinery; the new hazard positivity/minimum has its stated extra hypotheses. Fixture tables are exact analytical probabilities from rational Q, not newly acquired observations or a rank test from finite data. Query count, exact bit lengths, H conditioning, minimum stationary mass and separation of joint hazards are paid; near-degeneracy allows arbitrarily poor conditioning. Two settings do not grant a full future actuator-response oracle.

requires: Finite stationary CTMC with unknown finite count/rates, positive relevant stationary support, reciprocal support for finite entropy, all-even convention and a qualified noninvasive binary sensor.

Known independent calibrated Poisson inspections; two actual selective cross-label settings with unchanged same-label rates and adjusted diagonals. Local detailed-balance ratios alone do not qualify this actuator.
